[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The ACE Artifacts tab gains a sixth "Files" sub-tab that makes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]every indexed artifact file browsable by kind, project, agent, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]origin, and time — with the same marks, copy mode, references, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]filters, and jump machinery as its sibling panes — and puts each [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]file one keypress from the preview reader or the rich terminal [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]viewer, so the 4,000-file store stops being reachable only through [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the one agent run that produced each file.[/#D7D7AF]
